comment: Independent runtime witness for mon.c:newcham -> trap.c:mselftouch. #wizgenesis creates a hostile chameleon and #wizwish places a cockatrice corpse on the floor; after the hero moves, the chameleon changes into an ice troll. C newcham calls mselftouch after the form change, but the monster has no corpse weapon, so mselftouch returns through its no-wielded-corpse guard. This matching recording covers the call entry and early return only; the corpse-contact branch is not exercised.
